info.animate_values: Numbers count up from zero to their final form the first time they scroll into view. Prefix, units and formatting (10,000+, 98%, €1.2M) are preserved. Values with no clear number (e.g. 24/7) are left as-is.
info.animate_duration: How long the count-up runs. Leave at 0 to use the theme-wide default (Won · Number animation); set a value to override it for this section only.
info.countup_group: Default count-up behaviour for the whole theme. Individual sections can override it with their own duration.
info.countup_default_duration: Default count-up length for sections whose duration is set to 0 (inherit from theme).
info.loop: Slider only. Loops the rail endlessly so it never hits an empty end — pick where it applies.
info.video_autoplay: Plays silently on load (muted, as browsers require). Uncheck to show a play button instead.
info.device_scope: Choose which screens this section shows on. Sticky bars are usually best on mobile only.
info.default_tab: Make this the tab that's open when the page loads. If several are ticked, the first one wins.
info.announcement_bar_about: A slim bar at the very top of every page. Add rotating messages (or a free-shipping progress message), set how often they rotate, the alignment and whether shoppers can dismiss it. Store-wide news, not page content.
info.band_about: A flexible media + text row — image or video on one side, heading, copy and up to two buttons on the other. Add a second image for a centre-gutter layout, an overlay, or set a minimum height. Your go-to story block, feature callout or promo.
info.carousel_about: A horizontal row of items too wide for one screen — products from a collection, or manual Won Slide blocks you add. Choose slider, grid or marquee, toggle arrows, dots, progress and autoplay, and set columns per device. For a full-width hero use Won Hero – carousel.
info.collection_about: A grid of products from one collection. Toggle the title, description, filters and sort, set columns per device and products per page, and optionally show price-per-unit. A shop-the-range or bestsellers block.
info.comparison_about: A side-by-side feature comparison — you vs the alternative. Write one row per line (cells split by |, use yes/no for ✓/✗ or dots:2/4 for a rating) and highlight your column. Make your advantages obvious.
info.contact_about: A contact section — a standalone form, or a form split beside your details, image or map. Toggle the phone field, set the success message and layout. For a contact or support page.
info.footer_about: The site footer at the bottom of every page. Add menu columns, brand text, payment icons and legal links. Appears everywhere — set it once.
info.grid_about: A tidy grid of cards. Pick the source — Blocks (Won Feature / Tile / Slide you add below), Articles from a blog, or Stats from a text field. Set columns per device, a mosaic layout or a swipeable mobile row. Cards inherit your Won styling.
info.hero_about: A single full-width hero — one headline, image and call to action, built from a Won Slide block. Set the stage height and accent. For rotating slides use Won Hero – carousel.
info.hero_carousel_about: A full-width hero that rotates through several Won Slide slides. Choose Fill or Peek layout, toggle arrows, progress and autoplay. When one hero can't carry every message.
info.hero_grid_about: A hero built from Won Slide tiles side by side — one big story plus supporting cards. Set the number of columns and gap. A bold, editorial page top.
info.marquee_about: A continuously scrolling strip (USP / deals / logos). Add your own text or image tokens, set the speed and direction, pick a separator glyph (or none) and pause-on-hover. Trust badges, shipping perks or brand logos.
info.media_compare_about: A before/after image slider the shopper drags. Set the two images, their labels and the start position. Show a transformation or result.
info.newsletter_about: An email sign-up block to grow your list. Set the heading, body, field placeholder, button label, benefits line and success message.
info.page_header_about: The title area at the top of a page or collection — heading, subheading and an optional background image with overlay. Set the height and content alignment.
info.panels_about: Content shown as tabs or an accordion — add rows as Won Panel blocks. Great for FAQs, specs or anything better folded away until needed. Optionally add a side image and a contact prompt.
info.shoppable_image_about: A lifestyle image with clickable hotspots — add a hotspot per product so shoppers can buy straight from the scene. Set the image, aspect ratio and corner radius.
info.tabbed_rail_about: A product rail with tabs — add a tab per collection (e.g. Bestsellers ⇄ New in) so shoppers switch ranges without more sections. Set columns per device and card aspect.
info.variant_picker_about: The product's variant selector (size, colour…) plus add-to-cart. Choose how each option renders (buttons, swatches…), show a variant table, price-per-unit or a quantity field, and set the button label. Styled to match your Won look.
info.grid_source: Blocks = a grid of Won Feature / Tile / Slide blocks you add below. Articles = cards pulled from a blog. Stats = a number row from the text field.
info.stats: One stat per line as value : label, with an optional icon/emoji as a third part: value : label : icon.
info.rows_compare: One row per line, cells separated by | . Use yes / no (or ano / ne) for ✓ / ✗, or dots:2/4 for a quality rating (2 of 4 dots filled).
info.headline_annotation: Draw a hand-sketched underline or circle on the heading, in the accent colour (flow-style).
info.mosaic: Lets a tile set to Large span 2×2 for a magazine-style layout.
info.mobile_carousel: On phones, show the items as a single swipeable row (with a peek of the next card) instead of stacking them — keeps a long list of tiles from making the page very tall.
info.columns_mobile: How many items sit side by side on phones. Hidden when the mobile carousel is on.
info.hero_layout: Single stage = one hero; Slider = a swipeable set of hero slides. Add / edit the slides as Won Slide blocks inside this section.
info.hero_min_height: Stage height. Each slide can override it with its own minimum height.
info.hero_slider_layout: Fill = one full-bleed slide at a time. Peek = a centred card with the previous / next slide peeking in on both sides (koto-style).
info.slide_width: Peek only: how wide the centred card is on desktop. Lower = more of the neighbours peek in.
info.slide_min_height: Used mainly for background slides so the stage has height. 0 = auto.
info.app_slot: A landing spot for a Won app block. Add the app block here once installed; until then it shows the placeholder heading, text and button you set below.
info.ppu_amount: Net weight in grams (for 100 g / kg) or number of servings.
info.ppu_metafield: Optional. e.g. won.net_weight_g — overrides the reference amount when present.
info.stock_delivery: Shown when metafield won.delivery is empty.
info.ship_threshold: Order value (in your currency) for free shipping.
info.sticky_atc: A sticky buy bar that mirrors the variant picker and appears when the buy area scrolls away. Choose Full, Centered pill or Corner card, set the button label, roundness and offset.
info.sticky_style: Full spans the screen edge-to-edge. Centered pill and Corner card float above the page with rounded corners.
info.sticky_radius: Roundness of the floating Centered/Corner styles (ignored by Full).
info.sticky_offset: Gap between a floating bar and the bottom of the screen (ignored by Full).
info.nutrition_metafield: Metafield to read, as namespace.key (e.g. custom.nutrition). Works with a list of text lines, a multi-line text field, or a JSON object. The theme editor shows setup steps when it's empty.
info.label_col2_json: Leave blank to hide the second value column (also hidden for JSON metafields).
info.image_asset: Optional. Filename of a packaged theme image (in assets/) to use when no image is picked above — used for demo content. Pick your own image and it always wins.
info.image_2: Second image for the center-gutter layout — sits on the opposite side of the centred text.
info.footer_links: One per line, format: Label | url
info.footer_menu: Pick a navigation menu, or leave empty and use the manual links below.
info.tile_collection: Pick a collection to auto-use its image, title and link. A manual image/heading/link below overrides it.
info.tile_icon: Optional icon/emoji shown before the label (e.g. 💪, 🛡️) — great for shop-by-goal grids.
info.badge_text: Small corner label on the tile (e.g. New, −20%, Bestseller). Empty = no badge.
info.panels_display: Tabs = one panel at a time with a tab bar. Accordion = expandable FAQ rows. Add rows as Won Panel blocks below.
info.panel_open: Accordion mode only: this panel starts expanded.
info.split_side: Split FAQ only: what sits in the side column — the heading/contact, an image, or both.
info.split_position: Which side the image/heading column sits on: Start = left, End = right (they stack on mobile).
info.split_media: The image shown in the side column of a split FAQ. Empty shows a placeholder to replace.
info.corner_radius: Rounds the corners of cards/media in this block. 0 = square.
info.border_width: Adds an outline around the whole section. 0 = no border.
info.border_color: Color of the section outline (only when width is above 0).
info.shadow: Lifts the section off the page with a drop shadow. None = flat.
info.accent_color: Overrides this section's accent (buttons, prices, highlights) — leave empty to use the theme accent.
info.bg_color: Section background. Empty = inherit the Color scheme above (Settings → Colors). Pick a color to override just this section — both ways work.
info.text_color: Section text color. Empty = inherit the Color scheme above. Pick a color to override just this section — both ways work.
info.hide_mobile: Hides this whole section on phones (under 750px). It stays visible on desktop.
info.hide_desktop: Hides this whole section on desktop (750px and up). It stays visible on mobile.
info.heading_weight: Boldness of this section's headings. Theme = keep the theme's weight.
info.letter_spacing: Spacing between letters in this section. Theme = keep the theme default.
info.line_height: Spacing between lines of text. Theme = keep the theme default.
info.text_transform: Force UPPERCASE or Capitalize this section's text. None = leave as written.
info.animate_in: Plays a short entry animation when the section first appears. Respects reduced-motion.
info.advanced_about: Power-user overrides. Safe to ignore — the controls above cover nearly everything.
info.show_advanced: Reveals raw overrides below. Off keeps the editor simple.
info.pad_inline: Left/right padding inside the section band. 0 = the theme default.
info.section_opacity: Fades the whole section. 100% = fully opaque.
info.custom_shadow: A raw CSS box-shadow value (e.g. 0 10px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.2)). Overrides the Shadow option above.
info.overlay: Darkens the media with a color tint so text on top stays readable.
info.overlay_color: Color and opacity of that tint (use the alpha slider).
info.media_position: Where the image sits: above the text, beside it, or as a full background behind it.
info.background_gradient: A CSS colour or gradient behind the slide (for a photo-free gradient hero). Pair a vivid gradient with a matching colour scheme so the text stays legible.
info.card_style: Minimal = no frame. Bordered = thin outline. Elevated = surface + shadow.
info.inherit_color_scheme: On = use the section’s colors. Off = pick a different scheme for this block.
info.section_width: Page = aligned to the content width. Full = edge-to-edge (best for background media).
info.color_scheme: One of the theme color schemes (Settings → Colors).
info.token_kind: A text token or an image token (e.g. a small logo).
info.marquee_link: Optional: turn this text token into a link.
info.marquee_duration: How long one full loop takes. Lower = faster.
info.pause_on_hover: Stop the scroll while the pointer is over the strip.
info.tabrail_title: Tab label. Empty = the collection's name.
info.hotspot_pos: Position of the pin on the image, as a percentage from the top-left.
info.hotspot_mobile_pos: On: this pin uses its own position on phones (the mobile fields below); off: it keeps the desktop position everywhere.
info.hotspot_label: Optional label shown instead of the product's title.
info.columns: How many items sit side by side on desktop.
info.hero_grid_columns: How many tiles side by side on desktop. Add or remove tiles freely below — tablet shows 2, mobile 1.
info.ann_display: Rotate cycles messages one at a time; Single shows only the first block.
info.ann_interval: How long each message stays visible (rotate only).
info.ann_dismissible: Adds a close button; the bar stays hidden for the rest of the visit.
info.ann_link: Optional: make the whole message a link (e.g. to a new collection).
info.show_side_media: Adds an image beside the heading and contact in the side column. The heading and the FAQ questions always stay — this never hides them.
